extends Node
class_name QualityManager

enum Tier { LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH }

@export var tier: Tier = Tier.MEDIUM

func _ready() -> void:
    apply_quality(tier)

func apply_quality(value: Tier) -> void:
    tier = value
    match tier:
        Tier.LOW:
            get_viewport().scaling_3d_scale = 0.72
        Tier.MEDIUM:
            get_viewport().scaling_3d_scale = 0.88
        Tier.HIGH:
            get_viewport().scaling_3d_scale = 1.0
